notes: Volumetric (Micromeritics 3Flex) H2 excess isotherms at 77 K (liquid N2) and 87 K (liquid Ar), 0-1 kPa, on graphene sheets (GS, from thermally expanded rGO) and Cabot BP280 graphitized carbon black; Ar 87 K BET areas 220.5 and 36.1 m2/g. BP280 alone satisfies I2 (99.02 at% C by EDS). GS is 78.88 at% C by EDS with O, P, Cl, Nb; converting the Table 1 atom percentages to mass gives about 57 wt% C, so GS is also majority carbon by mass. Uptake values are very low-pressure (Henry region) only. No retraction statement and no statement that the data were published before; is_retracted is false. Full text has no supplementary file.
